name: UI: roleplay card
description: The roleplay card of renders 18 and 22: a title bar, speech bubbles whose tails point at whoever is speaking (hero gold, ally blue-white, mystic violet), and a caption, over the table of the tavern. The backdrop is render 18 with its bubbles painted out. Every bubble is a component drawn from data and changeable live with scene roleplay set.

bubbles.speaker: Lyra
bubbles.line: We're looking for a guide to the Ember Roads. Someone reliable. Any suggestions?

bubbles.speaker: Thoren
bubbles.line: Not mercenaries. A local who knows the real dangers.

bubbles.speaker: Innkeeper
bubbles.line: Depends... are you after a safe road, or the fast one? Both have a price.

bubbles.speaker: Seris
bubbles.line: What kind of dangers are we talking about?

bubbles.speaker: Kael
bubbles.line: Price isn't the issue. We just need the truth.

roleplay.caption: The party questions a local about recent events on the Ember Roads.

phone.goal: Find a guide to the Ember Roads
narration: The innkeeper wipes a mug and waits for your answer.
